title: Nearly Seven Miles Down, Their Window Cracked

scenes.text: A window cracked nearly seven miles under the ocean.
In January 1960, the Trieste dived into the Mariana Trench.
It reached 35,797 feet, the deepest point in the sea.
The descent took almost five hours, in a tiny cabin in total darkness.
At 32,400 feet, a loud crack shook the craft. A viewing port had cracked.
They stayed twenty minutes, then rose. Seven miles of ocean overhead.

description:
A window cracked nearly seven miles under the ocean.
In 1960, Don Walsh and Jacques Piccard rode the bathyscaphe Trieste 35,797 feet down into the Mariana Trench, and a viewing port cracked on the way.
Would you have gone? Comment below.
first_comment: Would you ride a steel cabin to the deepest point of the ocean?
